_comment: Exploratory (gate-failed) development backtest mode for Agentic Causal RAG. Recorded 2026-10-29 on the project lead's written instruction: run the complete development backtest on the current qwen3:4b model and existing prompts first, and investigate reliability afterwards as a separate experiment.

decision.what: Permit the 95-month development replay and its downstream evaluation to run although pre-registered reliability gates failed.
decision.purpose: Establish a reproducible end-to-end baseline of the full pipeline with genuine LLM outputs. It is a diagnostic, not a validation.

permits: the development replay 2015-02..2022-12 and scoring on 2019-03..2022-12 after a gate failure, when explicitly requested
importing those genuine outputs and carrying them through calibration, allocation and the shared evaluator
reporting the resulting portfolio metrics, clearly labelled as exploratory and not validated
never_permits: changing gate definitions, thresholds, prompts, limits, the rubric or the fixtures
hiding or softening the failed gates: every output carries them with their real values
scoring any month of the protected window 2023-01..2026-08, with or without this mode
use as the confirmatory input: historical_evaluation refuses any Causal RAG input carrying the exploratory banner
treating engineering-mock output as a result, or filling in months that were never run
presenting these results as evidence that the agents are reliable or that AI adds investment value

run_1_outcome.G3b: FAILED: accuracy 0.533 against 0.80 required; 2 opposite-direction errors against at most 1
run_1_outcome.G3a: FAILED: 12 of 12 sample months with no final answer

labelling.label: EXPLORATORY — RELIABILITY GATES FAILED
labelling.status_line: EXPLORATORY DIAGNOSTIC of a documented model substitution (qwen3:4b): the pre-registered reliability gates G3a and/or G3b did not pass, so these outputs are not validated agent results and are not evidence of investment performance. Development months only; the protected window stays sealed.
labelling.where: the results bundle, the evaluation output, every decision record written, and the dashboard view

model.name: qwen3:4b
model.served: Ollama on the run machine (localhost only); documented substitution for Llama 3.1 70B

agent_protocol.note: 1.1 fixes harness defects found in run 1 (the final-answer turn, the agent's own replies returned as assistant turns, whole-word graph search, rival-id validation). The agent prompts, schemas, limits, rubric, fixtures and gate thresholds are unchanged.

evidence.point_in_time: evidence and mediators are filtered to the decision time for every month

follow_up: Reliability improvement is a separate, later experiment with its own version and its own fixtures; the baseline recorded here is not modified after its results are seen (native_backtest/config/ap3_reliability_followup_preregistration_v1.json).
